title: 第5章 羞恼的曲柔第6章 悲愤的李蒙
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
仰慕了她数十载？
曲柔面露怪异之色。
被一个大限将至的外门弟子仰慕了几十年。
这让她有一种很奇怪的感觉。
“你是炼丹师？”
曲柔看了一眼屋内。
李蒙呵呵一笑。
“略懂一二，略懂一二！”
曲柔一脸无语的看着眼前的老头。
略懂一二能够炼制出无瑕丹药？
曲柔没有再废话，谈起了正事。
“你可有解决我体内火毒的办法？”
李蒙呵呵一笑，捋了捋胡须。
眼睛微眯，目光有些放肆的打量着曲师叔的曼妙娇躯。
曲柔秀眉微皱，面露温怒之色。
要是放在平日里，她一定得教训她一番。
让她知道在修仙界中管好自己的眼睛命才活得长。
“不难！”
不难？
曲柔脸上的怒意一扫而空。

“如果师侄能够解决我体内的火毒，师侄尽可提出条件，我都答应！”
李蒙呵呵一笑，捋了捋长长的胡须。
没有急着给予曲柔答复。
李蒙进入了院子，在躺椅上坐了下来。
“曲师叔，你应该能够看出师侄大限将至吧。”
曲柔扫了一眼李蒙。
她能够感觉到眼前这个外门弟子身上浓郁的死气。
这种气息只存在于那些即将坐化的修士身上。
“哪怕是元婴修士也很难得到一颗寿元果，如果师侄想要活命，我无能为力！”
修仙界只有一样东西能够增加寿命。
那就是有价无市的寿元果。
这等稀世珍宝哪是她小小筑基修士能够觊觎的。
而且她身上的火毒也不值一颗寿元果。
李蒙转头看向了沐浴在月光下的曲师叔。
她真的很美很美。
content_en:
Have you admired her for decades?
Qu Rou had a strange expression on her face.
He has been admired for decades by an outer disciple who is approaching his end.
This gave her a very strange feeling.
"Are you an alchemist?"
Qu Rou glanced inside the room.
Li Meng chuckled.
"I know a little bit, I know a little bit!"
Qu Rou looked at the old man in front of her speechlessly.
Can you refine a flawless elixir with a little knowledge?
Qu Rou stopped talking nonsense and got down to business.
"Do you have a solution for the fire poison in my body?"
Li Meng chuckled and stroked his beard.
He narrowed his eyes slightly and looked at Master Qu's graceful body with a somewhat wanton look.
Qu Rou frowned slightly, her face showing warmth and anger.
If it were normal, she would definitely have to teach her a lesson.
Let her know that in the world of immortality, you can live longer by taking good care of your eyes.
"It's not difficult!"
Not difficult?
The anger on Qu Rou's face disappeared.
"If my nephew can cure the fire poison in my body, my nephew can put forward any conditions, and I will agree to them!"
Li Meng chuckled and stroked his long beard.
There was no rush to give Qu Rou a reply.
Li Meng entered the courtyard and sat down on the deck chair.
"Uncle Qu, you should be able to tell that my nephew's time is approaching."
Qu Rou glanced at Li Meng.
She could feel the strong death energy on the outer disciple in front of her.
This kind of aura only exists in those monks who are about to sit down.
"Even a Nascent Soul cultivator has a hard time getting a Longevity Fruit. If my nephew wants to survive, there is nothing I can do!"
There is only one thing in the world of immortality that can increase life span.
That is the longevity fruit that has a price but no market.
Such rare treasures are not something that her little foundation-building monk can covet.
And the fire poison on her body is not worth a longevity fruit.
Li Meng turned to look at Uncle Qu, who was bathed in the moonlight.
She is really beautiful.
